A '''Spying Portal''' is a weave in the [[One Power]]. It is very similar to the portal for [[Traveling]], but it opens in horizontal, not in vertical. It was conceived by [[Yukiri]] opening it very far above in sky to spy an enemy army on the ground.

Yukiri made also two modification to this kind of portal: added a weave to make it invisible from the enemies on the ground and another one, like a transparent not frangible glass, to prevent anyone to drop into the portal by accident.
